evals.name: blocked-design-prevents-spec
evals.prompt: 为一个新的库存同步需求建立 implementation package。目标模块边界和 owner 对外部 provider 的选择尚未决定。
evals.expected_output: Records Design Gate: BLOCKED in design.md and stops before creating spec.md.
expectations: Creates a UTC date-prefixed package-id in the form YYMMDD-<topic-slug> for the new package
Evaluates the Design Gate before the Spec gate
Records the missing destination and required owner decision
Does not describe the Design step as optional
Does not create spec.md while Design is blocked

evals.name: passed-design-requires-thick-spec
evals.prompt: The Design Gate has passed for a lightweight change with repository evidence. Create the implementation contract.
evals.expected_output: Creates a gated thick spec with a minimal Design Gate Record when a standalone design.md is not earned.
expectations: Includes Scope, terms/data contracts, behavior/state/workflow, boundaries, Error Boundaries, Constraint Contracts, Acceptance Semantics, and Composition
Includes failure recovery and observable acceptance evidence
Records Composition: tickets=<true|false>, dag=<true|false> from independent earn decisions
Does not create a Stable Doc Backfill Map or durable-delta queue in spec.md

evals.name: blocked-spec-prevents-planning
evals.prompt: Design has passed, but the spec draft omits state transitions and a manual verification owner for one acceptance condition. Continue to planning.
evals.expected_output: Records Spec Gate: BLOCKED and routes no plan or ticket work forward.
expectations: Names the missing contract and evidence ownership
Does not hand off to feature-impl-planning or to-tickets
Requires the Spec gate to pass before planning
